question.problem:
Consider the function $y=\sqrt{\frac{{x}^{4}+2x}{{x}^{2}+2x+2}}.$ The derivative of this function is given by

$$
{y}^{′}=\frac{a{x}^{5}+3{x}^{4}+b{x}^{3}-{x}^{2}+c}{({x}^{2}+2x+2)^{3/2}\sqrt{{x}^{4}+2x}}.
$$

Find the value of $a+b+c.$
question.worked_solution:
Our function can be written as

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =\sqrt{\frac{{x}^{4}+2x}{{x}^{2}+2x+2}} \\  & =\frac{\sqrt{{x}^{4}+2x}}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+2x+2}} \\  & =\frac{({x}^{4}+2x)^{1/2}}{({x}^{2}+2x+2)^{1/2}}.\end{aligned}
$$

First, we take the natural logarithm of both sides and use the quotient and power rules for logarithms:

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{ln}⁡y & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(\frac{({x}^{4}+2x)^{1/2}}{({x}^{2}+2x+2)^{1/2}}) \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡y & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(({x}^{4}+2x)^{1/2})-\operatorname{ln}⁡(({x}^{2}+2x+2)^{1/2}) \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡y & =\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{4}+2x)-\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2}+2x+2)\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we differentiate both sides with respect to $x:$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{ln}⁡y) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{4}+2x)-\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2}+2x+2)) \\ \frac{1}{y}\cdot {y}^{′} & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot \frac{1}{{x}^{4}+2x}\cdot (4{x}^{3}+2)-\frac{1}{2}\cdot \frac{1}{{x}^{2}+2x+2}\cdot (2x+2) \\ \frac{{y}^{′}}{y} & =\frac{2{x}^{3}+1}{{x}^{4}+2x}-\frac{x+1}{{x}^{2}+2x+2}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Now, we solve for ${y}^{′}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{′} & =y(\frac{2{x}^{3}+1}{{x}^{4}+2x}-\frac{x+1}{{x}^{2}+2x+2})\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute $y=\sqrt{\frac{{x}^{4}+2x}{{x}^{2}+2x+2}}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{′} & =\sqrt{\frac{{x}^{4}+2x}{{x}^{2}+2x+2}}(\frac{2{x}^{3}+1}{{x}^{4}+2x}-\frac{x+1}{{x}^{2}+2x+2}) \\  & =\sqrt{\frac{{x}^{4}+2x}{{x}^{2}+2x+2}}(\frac{(2{x}^{3}+1)({x}^{2}+2x+2)-(x+1)({x}^{4}+2x)}{({x}^{4}+2x)({x}^{2}+2x+2)}) \\  & =\sqrt{\frac{{x}^{4}+2x}{{x}^{2}+2x+2}}(\frac{2{x}^{5}+4{x}^{4}+4{x}^{3}+{x}^{2}+2x+2-({x}^{5}+{x}^{4}+2{x}^{2}+2x)}{({x}^{4}+2x)({x}^{2}+2x+2)}) \\  & =\sqrt{\frac{{x}^{4}+2x}{{x}^{2}+2x+2}}(\frac{{x}^{5}+3{x}^{4}+4{x}^{3}-{x}^{2}+2}{({x}^{4}+2x)({x}^{2}+2x+2)}) \\  & =\frac{1{x}^{5}+3{x}^{4}+4{x}^{3}-{x}^{2}+2}{({x}^{2}+2x+2)^{3/2}\sqrt{{x}^{4}+2x}}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore,

$$
a+b+c=1+4+2=7.
$$
